text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and drink enough water. Second, exercise regularly — even a thirty-minute walk each day makes a big difference. Third, make sure you get enough sleep, because rest helps your body and brain recover. Mental health is just as important as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance: don't spend all your time working, and enjoy hobbies with friends and family. Small daily habits like these lead to a healthier, happier life.
